mac-heavy-guard.approval_scope: Finite full-source/deciding-interface audit for this exact key and README contract, preserving C1 partial and MHG-N2..N5 limits; not whole-system safety, registry admission, enrollment, deployment or installed parity.

executable_closure.assessment: No tool registration. Registered callbacks tested, not merely classify(). Local hook is active on Darwin unless MAC_HEAVY_GUARD=0; exported MAC_HEAVY_OK nonempty/nonzero bypasses. Inline opt-out is the existing env-name policy. terminal/process_manage/process command arguments and recursive tool_call/mcp__tool_call only; no claim for arbitrary execution tools.

Custom SourceFileLoader bypasses pyc, module reload by mtime_ns+size, decision lock across refresh/enabled/classify/message. Failed refresh retains last good module. This unchanged advisory reload is not a cryptographic source identity boundary or proof the first generation is installed.

Explicit workdir wins; otherwise task resolver and tracked environment cwd, then None fallback on any import/lookup error. Read exact core resolver/source: task/session context supplies IDs; local cwd is the tracked environment string. No SQL call made in this audit. Full backend/environment implementation and target installed version remain separately managed, not blanket-approved.

executable_closure.from: core plugin facade/discovery/loader/context/dispatch -> agent runtime/tool_executor -> lifecycle
executable_closure.target: selected hook registration and action:block enforcement
executable_closure.assessment: Read substantive gate_manifest enabled/disabled opt-in, directory source loader, register(ctx), track_hook and invoke_hook. Dispatcher collects non-None results; callback failures/timeouts produce policy blocks on this captured core. Lifecycle recognizes action:block; tool_executor runs pre-tool veto before dispatch. Plugin internal catch-all returning None hides exceptions from even this fail-closed dispatcher. Safe mode/safe workers/discovery suppression, source winner selection, catalog/review registration, profile context, ledger ownership and timeout machinery remain managed-core trust boundaries; not enrolled or exercised against production discovery.

executable_closure.target: sibling guard.py evaluate and Claude PreToolUse JSON/exit protocol
executable_closure.assessment: Fresh sibling load, supplied session cwd, exit2+stderr on hold, exit0 and optional additionalContext on allowed targeted test. Actual script exercised both runpy and fixture subprocesses; external Claude application honoring exit2 is trusted separately, not installed proof. Malformed JSON retains existing exit0 behavior.

executable_closure.from: guard.py copied shared block and mac-specific global rebinding
executable_closure.target: heredoc parser / _mac_hd_substitutions / command-substitution scanner / _ansi_word / typed events
executable_closure.assessment: Shared block is included source, not a runtime sibling import. Mac-specific override changes the global _hd_substitutions binding, so its effective behavior was read after the copied block. Two repaired typed boundaries: second join at 1239 inside try, heredoc ownership at 1706-1714. Only _UnsupportedSubstitution becomes a hold; independently injected RuntimeError propagates through check_shell/evaluate/note/commands where relevant. Public commands emits simple argv and holds as ValueError, not private events. Other plugins with copied text are not approved.

Read classification tables, SSH explicit local option scans and strict remote heredoc exemption, runner/argv grammar, large-file stats, script path resolution, shebang selection and <=64KiB/two-level bounds. Files are read as data, never executed by guard. Existence/executable/shebang rules and NUL behavior retained. Read/execute races, symlink replacement, ambient variable/alias/SSH configuration and unmodeled launchers remain limits, not containment guarantees.

executable_closure.target: core_worktree -> PATH git -C <dir> config --get remote.origin.url; evaluate/note/core-test hints
executable_closure.assessment: Fixed list argv, no shell, 3-second timeout, .git plus scripts/run_tests.sh precondition; origin regex controls advice. Sparse-file/cwd/git fixture tests executed. System git binary, its config/includes and PATH are separately trusted. No hub operation is invoked: hermes-core-wt is only recommendation text. Notes are bounded pending metadata, not workload enrollment.

executable_closure.target: dynamic sibling MHG guard -> strict _tokens/_lexable overrides -> commands/check_argv -> workload_reason
executable_closure.assessment: Read full workload classifier, local shell/shebang fallback and error conversion. Strict raw parser overrides preserve malformed-command refusal; commands ValueError propagates as unclassifiable refusal; other parser failures are also converted into ValueError here. Actual workload_reason tested independently and throughout differential. Tailnet source is pinned to the same mods commit and included in closure map, not approved as a whole.

executable_closure.target: machine-wide workload-policy.json protected host selection and terminal_guard dynamic consumer
executable_closure.assessment: Read runner policy-before-key/execution path and terminal_guard in full. Policy version/address/alias validation, resolver, remote command extraction and classifier refusal are substantive deciding input. Offline protected fixture refused rc126 before tempdir/SSH; clean control reached no-key rc255. Terminal guard also calls same runner classifier after target matching. DNS/ssh-G lookup, actual SSH/SCP/SFTP/rsync transport, credentials and production policy file identity are separate unexercised trust boundaries; no network or credential probe performed.

Called real committed producer under fixture host eligibility, retained exact output bytes in evidence/nice-prefix.txt and replayed every input both plain and prefixed. No renice or prefixed commands executed. Host allowlist/default nice/priority execution remains separately managed; this audit checks parser/consumer parity only.

executable_closure.target: Python stdlib/importlib/os/shlex/stat/subprocess/pathlib/json/threading; OS/filesystem; external Bash and Claude semantics
executable_closure.assessment: No blanket approval of interpreter, OS, shell engine, core, tailnet plugin or other guard keys. Production source parity, natural workload conditions, unknown/latency accounting and mature standard checks remain unverified and owned by parent.
